generateFullChecklist() {

'P0_CONCURRENCY_RESILIENCE',

'FORTRESS_IMMUTABILITY',

'RELATIONAL_ARCHITECTURE',

priority: this.calculatePriority(i, category),

retries: 0

});

}



return checklist;

}

// ============================// OBI_MIND Final Action V16.0// ============================class AuditSystem {

constructor() {

this.state = {

cycleCount: 0,

totalAudits: 0,

passed: 0,

failed: 0,

warnings: 0,

results: [],

isRunning: false

};



this.config = {

totalPoints: 1000,

concurrentBatches: 10,

pointsPerBatch: 100,

retryAttempts: 3,

reorganizeInterval: 10 // for demo: reorganize every 10 cycles

};



this.auditChecklist = this.generateFullChecklist();

this.executors = this.createExecutors();

}



generateFullChecklist() {

const categories = [

'P0_CRYPTOGRAPHY',

'P0_CONCURRENCY_RESILIENCE',

'FORTRESS_IMMUTABILITY',

'RELATIONAL_ARCHITECTURE',

'CONTEXTUAL_EFFICIENCY'

];

const checklist = [];

for (let i = 1; i <= this.config.totalPoints; i++) {

const category = categories[i % categories.length];

checklist.push({

ID: `AUDIT-${String(i).padStart(4, '0')}`,

FOCUS: category,

CHECK: `Validate ${category} checkpoint ${i}`,

FORMAT: `[${category}_CHECK_${i}: $RESULT]`,

priority: this.calculatePriority(i, category),

retries: 0

});

}

return checklist;

}



createExecutors() {

return {

P0_CRYPTOGRAPHY: async () => {

await this.delay(10);

const status = Math.random() < 0.99 ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';

return { status, value: status === 'PASS' ? 'SHA256_VALIDATED' : 'INTEGRITY_MISMATCH' };

},

P0_CONCURRENCY_RESILIENCE: async () => {

await this.delay(15);

const passed = Math.random() < 0.95;

return { status: passed ? 'PASS' : 'WARN', value: passed };

},

FORTRESS_IMMUTABILITY: async () => {

await this.delay(12);

return { status: 'PASS', value: true };

},

RELATIONAL_ARCHITECTURE: async () => {

await this.delay(8);

const passed = Math.random() < 0.97;

return { status: passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', value: passed ? 'OK' : 'MISMATCH' };

},

CONTEXTUAL_EFFICIENCY: async () => {

await this.delay(10);

const score = (Math.random() * 100).toFixed(2);

return { status: 'PASS', value: `Efficiency ${score}%` };

},

DEFAULT: async () => {

await this.delay(10);

return { status: 'PASS', value: true };

}

};

}



async executeAudit(audit) {

try {

const executor = this.executors[audit.FOCUS] || this.executors.DEFAULT;

const result = await executor(audit);



const formatted = audit.FORMAT.replace('$RESULT', result.value);



return {

...audit,

result: formatted,

status: result.status,

timestamp: new Date().toISOString()

};

} catch (error) {

if (audit.retries < this.config.retryAttempts) {

audit.retries++;

await this.delay(100);

return this.executeAudit(audit);

}

return {

...audit,

result: `[ERROR: ${error.message}]`,

status: 'FAIL',

timestamp: new Date().toISOString()

};

}

}



async executeBatch(batch) {

const promises = batch.map(audit => this.executeAudit(audit));

return await Promise.all(promises);

}



createBatches() {

const batches = [];

for (let i = 0; i < this.auditChecklist.length; i += this.config.pointsPerBatch) {

batches.push(this.auditChecklist.slice(i, i + this.config.pointsPerBatch));

}

return batches;

}



calculatePriority(index, category) {

if (category === 'P0_CRYPTOGRAPHY') return 1;

if (category === 'P0_CONCURRENCY_RESILIENCE') return 2;

if (category === 'FORTRESS_IMMUTABILITY') return 3;

if (category === 'RELATIONAL_ARCHITECTURE') return 4;

return 5; // CONTEXTUAL_EFFICIENCY

}



updateMetrics(results) {

results.forEach(result => {

this.state.totalAudits++;

if (result.status === 'PASS') this.state.passed++;

else if (result.status === 'FAIL') this.state.failed++;

else if (result.status === 'WARN') this.state.warnings++;

this.state.results.push(result);

});

}



reorganize() {

console.log('\n[REORGANIZATION] Reprioritizing failed and high-priority audits...');

const failedAudits = this.state.results.filter(r => r.status === 'FAIL');

if (failedAudits.length > 0) {

// Bring failed audits to the front of the checklist

const remaining = this.auditChecklist.filter(a => !failedAudits.find(f => f.ID === a.ID));

this.auditChecklist = [...failedAudits, ...remaining];

}

console.log(`[REORGANIZATION] ${failedAudits.length} failed audits reprioritized.`);

}



generateReport() {

return {

totalAudits: this.state.totalAudits,

passed: this.state.passed,

failed: this.state.failed,

warnings: this.state.warnings,

successRate: ((this.state.passed / this.state.totalAudits) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'

};

}



delay(ms) {

return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

}



async runContinuousAudit(cycles = 50) {

if (this.state.isRunning) {

console.log('[WARNING] Audit already running');

return;

}



this.state.isRunning = true;

console.log('[AUDIT ENGINE] Starting 1000-Point Continuous Diagnostic V16.0...\n');



const batches = this.createBatches();

const totalBatches = batches.length;



try {

for (let cycle = 1; cycle <= cycles; cycle++) {

this.state.cycleCount++;

console.log(`${'='.repeat(70)}`);

console.log(`CYCLE ${this.state.cycleCount} INITIATED`);

console.log('='.repeat(70));



for (let i = 0; i < totalBatches; i++) {

const results = await this.executeBatch(batches[i]);

this.updateMetrics(results);

console.log(

`[PROGRESS] Batch ${i + 1}/${totalBatches} Complete. Success Rate: ${((this.state.passed / this.state.totalAudits) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`

);

}



if (this.state.cycleCount % this.config.reorganizeInterval === 0) {

this.reorganize();

}

}



this.state.isRunning = false;

const report = this.generateReport();

console.log('\n[AUDIT COMPLETE] FINAL REPORT:', report);

return report;



} catch (error) {

console.error('[CRITICAL ERROR]', error);

this.state.isRunning = false;

throw error;

}

}

}// ============================// Production Initialization// ============================const auditSystem = new AuditSystem();

/* ------------------------------

4) Minimal manifest & audit record (mutable only until signing)

------------------------------ */

const V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST = {

manifestId: "v15-manifest-2025-10-28",

createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),

seedRef: "V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED",

seedSha256: "PLACEHOLDER_SEED_SHA256", // fill in after computing genuine digest in secure environment

pointsCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.length,

criticalCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="CRITICAL").length,

highCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="HIGH").length,

mediumCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="MEDIUM").length,

lowCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="LOW").length,

attestation: {

pqSignatureRef: "PLACEHOLDER_PQ_SIG_REF",

signerPublicKeyRef: "PLACEHOLDER_PQ_PUBKEY_REF",

signatureVerification: "PENDING" // set to "VERIFIED" after HSM verify step

},

notes: "This manifest must be sealed (PQ-signed) by an HSM-managed key and anchored into CCR before distribution."

};



/* ------------------------------

5) Release helper functions (safe to call in auditor env)

------------------------------ */



/**

* computeAndAttachManifestHashes()

* - Computes hash of immutables and returns a manifest snapshot that auditors can sign.

* - Warning: compute the hashes in a secure environment (HSM/air-gapped if required).

*/

async function computeAndAttachManifestHashes() {

try {

// Compute seed SHA256

const seedSha = await CryptoUtil.sha256Hex(V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED);

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.seedSha256 = seedSha;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.integrity.sha256 = seedSha;



// Compute manifest summary hash

const manifestDigest = await CryptoUtil.sha256Hex({

manifestId: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.manifestId,

seedSha256: seedSha,

pointsCount: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.pointsCount,

createdAt: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.createdAt

});

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.manifestHash = manifestDigest;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.integrity.manifestHash = manifestDigest;



return {

ok: true,

seedSha256: seedSha,

manifestHash: manifestDigest

};

} catch (err) {

return { ok: false, error: String(err) };

}

}



/**

* attachPqSignatureReference()

* - Placeholder to attach a PQ signature reference after HSM signing.

* - Inputs: signatureRef (string), pubkeyRef (string)

*/

function attachPqSignatureReference({ signatureRef, pubkeyRef }) {

if (!signatureRef || !pubkeyRef) {

throw new Error("signatureRef and pubkeyRef required");

}

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.pqSignatureRef = signatureRef;

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signerPublicKeyRef = pubkeyRef;

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signatureVerification = "PENDING";

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.pqSignatureRef = signatureRef;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.signer.publicKeyRef = pubkeyRef;

return true;

}



/**

* verifyAttestationPlaceholder()

* - Calls the placeholder PQ verify helper (actual verify must be done by HSM/PQ libs).

*/

async function verifyAttestationPlaceholder() {

const payload = {

seed: V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED,

manifest: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST

};

const { pqSignatureRef, signerPublicKeyRef } = V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation;

const check = await CryptoUtil.verifyPQSignature({

payload,

signature: pqSignatureRef, // placeholder token pointing to real HSM sig

publicKeyRef: signerPublicKeyRef

});

if (check.ok) {

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signatureVerification = "VERIFIED_PLACEHOLDER";

}

return check;

}

// auditExecutorV16.1.jsimport { Worker } from 'worker_threads';import pLimit from 'p-limit';import EventEmitter from 'events';class AuditSystemV16_1 extends EventEmitter {

constructor(auditChecklist = [], config = {}) {

super();

this.auditChecklist = auditChecklist; // 5000-point V16.1 checklist

this.state = {

totalAudits: 0,

passed: 0,

failed: 0,

warnings: 0,

cycleCount: 0,

isRunning: false,

results: [],

startTime: null

};

this.config = {

concurrentBatches: config.concurrentBatches || 2,

pointsPerBatch: config.pointsPerBatch || 100,

retryAttempts: config.retryAttempts || 3,

batchConcurrencyLimit: config.batchConcurrencyLimit || 20,

reorganizeInterval: config.reorganizeInterval || 5,

maxCycles: config.maxCycles || 50

};

}



// Worker thread for CPU-heavy audits

runWorker(taskData) {

return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

const worker = new Worker('./auditWorker.js', { workerData: taskData });

worker.once('message', resolve);

worker.once('error', reject);

worker.once('exit', code => code !== 0 && reject(new Error(`Worker stopped with code ${code}`)));

});

}



// Execute a single audit with retries, abort, and CPU offload

async executeAudit(audit) {

const startTime = Date.now();

const controller = new AbortController();

audit.retries = 0;



try {

let result;

for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= this.config.retryAttempts; attempt++) {

audit.retries = attempt;



if (audit.cpuHeavy) {

result = await this.runWorker({ audit });

} else {

result = await Promise.race([

audit.executor(audit),

new Promise((_, rej) =>

controller.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => rej(new Error('ABORTED')))

)

]);

}



if (result.status === 'PASS') break;

}



audit.executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;

audit.result = result;



// Atomic update of metrics

this.state.totalAudits++;

switch (result.status) {

case 'PASS': this.state.passed++; break;

case 'FAIL': this.state.failed++; break;

case 'WARN': this.state.warnings++; break;

}



// Deep-copy result to avoid mutable leaks

this.state.results.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(audit)));

this.emit('update', this.state);



return audit;

} catch (error) {

audit.executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;

audit.result = { status: 'ERROR', value: error.message };

this.state.failed++;

this.state.results.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(audit)));

this.emit('update', this.state);

return audit;

}

}



// Execute batch with controlled concurrency

async executeBatch(batch) {

const limit = pLimit(this.config.batchConcurrencyLimit);

const promises = batch.map(audit => limit(() => this.executeAudit(audit)));

return await Promise.allSettled(promises);

}



// Organize audits into batches by priority

organizeBatches() {

const sorted = [...this.auditChecklist].sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);

const batches = [];

for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i += this.config.pointsPerBatch) {

batches.push(sorted.slice(i, i + this.config.pointsPerBatch));

}

return batches;

}



// Run one audit cycle

async runCycle() {

if (this.state.isRunning) return;

this.state.isRunning = true;

this.state.startTime = Date.now();

this.state.cycleCount++;



const batches = this.organizeBatches();

for (let i = 0; i < batches.length; i += this.config.concurrentBatches) {

const batchGroup = batches.slice(i, i + this.config.concurrentBatches);

await Promise.all(batchGroup.map(batch => this.executeBatch(batch)));

console.log(`Completed batches ${i + 1}-${i + batchGroup.length} of cycle ${this.state.cycleCount}`);

}



// Anti-fragile reorganization

if (this.config.reorganizeInterval && this.state.cycleCount % this.config.reorganizeInterval === 0) {

this.auditChecklist.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);

}



this.state.isRunning = false;

console.log(`Cycle ${this.state.cycleCount} complete. Passed: ${this.state.passed}, Failed: ${this.state.failed}, Warnings: ${this.state.warnings}`);

}



// Continuous execution for all cycles

async runContinuous() {

while (this.state.cycleCount < this.config.maxCycles) {

await this.runCycle();

}

console.log('All audit cycles complete.');

}

}export default AuditSystemV16_1;

/**

* ===============================================

* OBI_MIND MISSION CONTROL V16.0 - 3000-Point

* Fully Executable Audit System

* ===============================================

*/

class AuditSystem {

constructor() {

this.state = {

cycleCount: 0,

totalAudits: 0,

passed: 0,

failed: 0,

warnings: 0,

results: [],

isRunning: false

};



this.config = {

totalPoints: 3000,

concurrentBatches: 30,

pointsPerBatch: 100,

retryAttempts: 3,

reorganizeInterval: 10 // reorg every 10 cycles

};



this.auditChecklist = this.generateFullChecklist();

this.executors = this.createExecutors();



// Hooks for live updates

this.onBatchComplete = null;

this.onCycleComplete = null;

}



// Generate 3000-point checklist dynamically

generateFullChecklist() {

const categories = [

'P0_CRYPTOGRAPHY',

'P0_CONCURRENCY_RESILIENCE',

'FORTRESS_IMMUTABILITY',

'RELATIONAL_ARCHITECTURE',

'CONTEXTUAL_EFFICIENCY'

];

const checklist = [];

for (let i = 1; i <= this.config.totalPoints; i++) {

const category = categories[i % categories.length];

checklist.push({

ID: `AUDIT-${String(i).padStart(4, '0')}`,

FOCUS: category,

CHECK: `Validate ${category} checkpoint ${i}`,

FORMAT: `[${category}_CHECK_${i}: $RESULT]`,

priority: this.calculatePriority(i, category),

retries: 0

});

}

return checklist;

}



// Async executors with realistic pass/fail/warning

createExecutors() {

return {

P0_CRYPTOGRAPHY: async () => {

await this.delay(5 + Math.random() * 10);

const status = Math.random() < 0.995 ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';

return { status, value: status === 'PASS' ? 'SHA256_VALIDATED' : 'INTEGRITY_MISMATCH' };

},

P0_CONCURRENCY_RESILIENCE: async () => {

await this.delay(5 + Math.random() * 10);

const passed = Math.random() < 0.97;

return { status: passed ? 'PASS' : 'WARN', value: passed };

},

FORTRESS_IMMUTABILITY: async () => {

await this.delay(5 + Math.random() * 8);

return { status: 'PASS', value: true };

},

RELATIONAL_ARCHITECTURE: async () => {

await this.delay(5 + Math.random() * 10);

const passed = Math.random() < 0.96;

return { status: passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', value: passed ? 'OK' : 'MISMATCH' };

},

CONTEXTUAL_EFFICIENCY: async () => {

await this.delay(5 + Math.random() * 10);

const score = (Math.random() * 100).toFixed(2);

return { status: 'PASS', value: `Efficiency ${score}%` };

},

DEFAULT: async () => {

await this.delay(5 + Math.random() * 10);

return { status: 'PASS', value: true };

}

};

}



calculatePriority(index, category) {

if (category === 'P0_CRYPTOGRAPHY') return 1;

if (category === 'P0_CONCURRENCY_RESILIENCE') return 2;

if (category === 'FORTRESS_IMMUTABILITY') return 3;

if (category === 'RELATIONAL_ARCHITECTURE') return 4;

return 5; // CONTEXTUAL_EFFICIENCY

}



delay(ms) {

return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

}



async executeAudit(audit) {

try {

const executor = this.executors[audit.FOCUS] || this.executors.DEFAULT;

const result = await executor(audit);



const formatted = audit.FORMAT.replace('$RESULT', result.value);



return {

...audit,

result: formatted,

status: result.status,

timestamp: new Date().toISOString()

};

} catch (error) {

if (audit.retries < this.config.retryAttempts) {

audit.retries++;

await this.delay(100);

return this.executeAudit(audit);

}

return {

...audit,

result: `[ERROR: ${error.message}]`,

status: 'FAIL',

timestamp: new Date().toISOString()

};

}

}



async executeBatch(batch, batchIndex) {

const promises = batch.map(audit => this.executeAudit(audit));

const results = await Promise.all(promises);

this.updateMetrics(results);



if (this.onBatchComplete) {

this.onBatchComplete(batchIndex, batch.length, this.state);

}



return results;

}



updateMetrics(results) {

results.forEach(result => {

this.state.totalAudits++;

if (result.status === 'PASS') this.state.passed++;

else if (result.status === 'FAIL') this.state.failed++;

else if (result.status === 'WARN') this.state.warnings++;

this.state.results.push(result);

});

}



createBatches() {

const batches = [];

for (let i = 0; i < this.auditChecklist.length; i += this.config.pointsPerBatch) {

batches.push(this.auditChecklist.slice(i, i + this.config.pointsPerBatch));

}

return batches;

}



reorganize() {

const failedAudits = this.state.results.filter(r => r.status === 'FAIL');

if (failedAudits.length > 0) {

const remaining = this.auditChecklist.filter(a => !failedAudits.find(f => f.ID === a.ID));

this.auditChecklist = [...failedAudits, ...remaining];

}

console.log(`[REORGANIZATION] ${failedAudits.length} failed audits reprioritized.`);

}



generateReport() {

return {

totalAudits: this.state.totalAudits,

passed: this.state.passed,

failed: this.state.failed,

warnings: this.state.warnings,

successRate: ((this.state.passed / this.state.totalAudits) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'

};

}



async runContinuousAudit(cycles = 50) {

if (this.state.isRunning) {

console.log('[WARNING] Audit already running');

return;

}



this.state.isRunning = true;

console.log('[AUDIT ENGINE] Starting 3000-Point Continuous Diagnostic V16.0...\n');



const batches = this.createBatches();

const totalBatches = batches.length;



try {

for (let cycle = 1; cycle <= cycles; cycle++) {

this.state.cycleCount++;

console.log(`${'='.repeat(80)}`);

console.log(`CYCLE ${this.state.cycleCount} INITIATED`);

console.log(`${'='.repeat(80)}`);



for (let i = 0; i < totalBatches; i++) {

await this.executeBatch(batches[i], i);

console.log(`[PROGRESS] Batch ${i + 1}/${totalBatches} complete. Success Rate: ${((this.state.passed / this.state.totalAudits) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`);

}



if (this.state.cycleCount % this.config.reorganizeInterval === 0) {

this.reorganize();

}



if (this.onCycleComplete) {

this.onCycleComplete({ cycle: this.state.cycleCount, ...this.state });

}

}



this.state.isRunning = false;

const report = this.generateReport();

console.log('\n[AUDIT COMPLETE] FINAL REPORT:', report);

return report;

} catch (error) {

console.error('[CRITICAL ERROR]', error);

this.state.isRunning = false;

throw error;

}

}

}

FOCUS: category,

return { status: 'PASS', value: true };

},

await this.delay(5 + Math.random() * 10);

const passed = Math.random() < 0.96;

return { status: passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', value: passed ? 'OK' : 'MISMATCH' };

},

},

DEFAULT: async () => {

};

calculatePriority(index, category) {

delay(ms) {

async executeAudit(audit) {

...audit,

result: formatted,

timestamp: new Date().toISOString()

};

};

}

async executeBatch(batch, batchIndex) {

updateMetrics(results) {

else if (result.status === 'FAIL') this.state.failed++;

else if (result.status === 'WARN') this.state.warnings++;

});

createBatches() {

batches.push(this.auditChecklist.slice(i, i + this.config.pointsPerBatch));

return batches;

reorganize() {

const failedAudits = this.state.results.filter(r => r.status === 'FAIL');

if (failedAudits.length > 0) {

const remaining = this.auditChecklist.filter(a => !failedAudits.find(f => f.ID === a.ID));

this.auditChecklist = [...failedAudits, ...remaining];

}



generateReport() {

totalAudits: this.state.totalAudits,

// ============================// OBI_MIND Final Action V16.0// ============================class AuditSystem {

constructor() {

cycleCount: 0,

totalAudits: 0,

passed: 0,

failed: 0,

warnings: 0,

results: [],

isRunning: false

totalPoints: 1000,

concurrentBatches: 10,

pointsPerBatch: 100,

retryAttempts: 3,

generateFullChecklist() {

'P0_CONCURRENCY_RESILIENCE',

'FORTRESS_IMMUTABILITY',

'RELATIONAL_ARCHITECTURE',

'CONTEXTUAL_EFFICIENCY'

];

FOCUS: category,

FORMAT: `[${category}_CHECK_${i}: $RESULT]`,

priority: this.calculatePriority(i, category),

retries: 0

});

}

return checklist;

}



createExecutors() {

P0_CRYPTOGRAPHY: async () => {

P0_CONCURRENCY_RESILIENCE: async () => {

},

return { status: 'PASS', value: true };

},

RELATIONAL_ARCHITECTURE: async () => {

await this.delay(8);

const passed = Math.random() < 0.97;

return { status: passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', value: passed ? 'OK' : 'MISMATCH' };

},

CONTEXTUAL_EFFICIENCY: async () => {

}

};

async executeAudit(audit) {

try {

const executor = this.executors[audit.FOCUS] || this.executors.DEFAULT;

...audit,

result: formatted,

status: result.status,

timestamp: new Date().toISOString()

};

...audit,

result: `[ERROR: ${error.message}]`,

status: 'FAIL',

timestamp: new Date().toISOString()

};

}

}



async executeBatch(batch) {

return await Promise.all(promises);

}



createBatches() {

const batches = [];

for (let i = 0; i < this.auditChecklist.length; i += this.config.pointsPerBatch) {

batches.push(this.auditChecklist.slice(i, i + this.config.pointsPerBatch));

}

calculatePriority(index, category) {

else if (result.status === 'WARN') this.state.warnings++;

this.auditChecklist = [...failedAudits, ...remaining];

generateReport() {

totalAudits: this.state.totalAudits,

delay(ms) {

);

}



if (this.state.cycleCount % this.config.reorganizeInterval === 0) {

}



this.state.isRunning = false;

/* ------------------------------

4) Minimal manifest & audit record (mutable only until signing)

------------------------------ */

const V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST = {

manifestId: "v15-manifest-2025-10-28",

createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),

seedRef: "V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED",

seedSha256: "PLACEHOLDER_SEED_SHA256", // fill in after computing genuine digest in secure environment

pointsCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.length,

criticalCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="CRITICAL").length,

highCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="HIGH").length,

mediumCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="MEDIUM").length,

lowCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="LOW").length,

attestation: {

pqSignatureRef: "PLACEHOLDER_PQ_SIG_REF",

signerPublicKeyRef: "PLACEHOLDER_PQ_PUBKEY_REF",

signatureVerification: "PENDING" // set to "VERIFIED" after HSM verify step

},

notes: "This manifest must be sealed (PQ-signed) by an HSM-managed key and anchored into CCR before distribution."

};



/* ------------------------------

5) Release helper functions (safe to call in auditor env)

------------------------------ */



/**

* computeAndAttachManifestHashes()

* - Computes hash of immutables and returns a manifest snapshot that auditors can sign.

* - Warning: compute the hashes in a secure environment (HSM/air-gapped if required).

*/

async function computeAndAttachManifestHashes() {

try {

// Compute seed SHA256

const seedSha = await CryptoUtil.sha256Hex(V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED);

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.seedSha256 = seedSha;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.integrity.sha256 = seedSha;



// Compute manifest summary hash

const manifestDigest = await CryptoUtil.sha256Hex({

manifestId: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.manifestId,

seedSha256: seedSha,

pointsCount: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.pointsCount,

createdAt: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.createdAt

});

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.manifestHash = manifestDigest;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.integrity.manifestHash = manifestDigest;



return {

ok: true,

seedSha256: seedSha,

manifestHash: manifestDigest

};

} catch (err) {

return { ok: false, error: String(err) };

}

}



/**

* attachPqSignatureReference()

* - Placeholder to attach a PQ signature reference after HSM signing.

* - Inputs: signatureRef (string), pubkeyRef (string)

*/

function attachPqSignatureReference({ signatureRef, pubkeyRef }) {

if (!signatureRef || !pubkeyRef) {

throw new Error("signatureRef and pubkeyRef required");

}

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.pqSignatureRef = signatureRef;

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signerPublicKeyRef = pubkeyRef;

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signatureVerification = "PENDING";

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.pqSignatureRef = signatureRef;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.signer.publicKeyRef = pubkeyRef;

return true;

}



/**

* verifyAttestationPlaceholder()

* - Calls the placeholder PQ verify helper (actual verify must be done by HSM/PQ libs).

*/

async function verifyAttestationPlaceholder() {

const payload = {

seed: V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED,

manifest: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST

};

const { pqSignatureRef, signerPublicKeyRef } = V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation;

const check = await CryptoUtil.verifyPQSignature({

payload,

signature: pqSignatureRef, // placeholder token pointing to real HSM sig

publicKeyRef: signerPublicKeyRef

});

if (check.ok) {

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signatureVerification = "VERIFIED_PLACEHOLDER";

}

return check;

}

/**

* computeAndAttachManifestHashes()

* - Computes hash of immutables and returns a manifest snapshot that auditors can sign.

* - Warning: compute the hashes in a secure environment (HSM/air-gapped if required).

*/

async function computeAndAttachManifestHashes() {

try {

// Compute seed SHA256

const seedSha = await CryptoUtil.sha256Hex(V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED);

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.seedSha256 = seedSha;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.integrity.sha256 = seedSha;



// Compute manifest summary hash

const manifestDigest = await CryptoUtil.sha256Hex({

manifestId: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.manifestId,

seedSha256: seedSha,

pointsCount: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.pointsCount,

createdAt: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.createdAt

});

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.manifestHash = manifestDigest;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.integrity.manifestHash = manifestDigest;



return {

ok: true,

seedSha256: seedSha,

manifestHash: manifestDigest

};

} catch (err) {

return { ok: false, error: String(err) };

}

}



/**

* attachPqSignatureReference()

* - Placeholder to attach a PQ signature reference after HSM signing.

*/

function attachPqSignatureReference({ signatureRef, pubkeyRef }) {

if (!signatureRef || !pubkeyRef) {

throw new Error("signatureRef and pubkeyRef required");

}

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.pqSignatureRef = signatureRef;

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signerPublicKeyRef = pubkeyRef;

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signatureVerification = "PENDING";

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.pqSignatureRef = signatureRef;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.signer.publicKeyRef = pubkeyRef;

return true;

}



/**

* verifyAttestationPlaceholder()

* - Calls the placeholder PQ verify helper (actual verify must be done by HSM/PQ libs).

*/

async function verifyAttestationPlaceholder() {

const payload = {

seed: V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED,

manifest: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST

};

const { pqSignatureRef, signerPublicKeyRef } = V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation;

const check = await CryptoUtil.verifyPQSignature({

payload,

signature: pqSignatureRef, // placeholder token pointing to real HSM sig

publicKeyRef: signerPublicKeyRef

});

if (check.ok) {

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signatureVerification = "VERIFIED_PLACEHOLDER";

}

return check;

}

------------------------------ */

const V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST = {

manifestId: "v15-manifest-2025-10-28",

createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),

seedRef: "V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED",

seedSha256: "PLACEHOLDER_SEED_SHA256", // fill in after computing genuine digest in secure environment

pointsCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.length,

criticalCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="CRITICAL").length,

highCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="HIGH").length,

mediumCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="MEDIUM").length,

lowCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="LOW").length,

attestation: {

pqSignatureRef: "PLACEHOLDER_PQ_SIG_REF",

signerPublicKeyRef: "PLACEHOLDER_PQ_PUBKEY_REF",

signatureVerification: "PENDING" // set to "VERIFIED" after HSM verify step

},

notes: "This manifest must be sealed (PQ-signed) by an HSM-managed key and anchored into CCR before distribution."

};



/* ------------------------------

5) Release helper functions (safe to call in auditor env)

------------------------------ */



/**

* computeAndAttachManifestHashes()

* - Computes hash of immutables and returns a manifest snapshot that auditors can sign.

* - Warning: compute the hashes in a secure environment (HSM/air-gapped if required).

*/

async function computeAndAttachManifestHashes() {

try {

// Compute seed SHA256

const seedSha = await CryptoUtil.sha256Hex(V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED);

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.seedSha256 = seedSha;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.integrity.sha256 = seedSha;



// Compute manifest summary hash

const manifestDigest = await CryptoUtil.sha256Hex({

manifestId: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.manifestId,

seedSha256: seedSha,

pointsCount: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.pointsCount,

createdAt: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.createdAt

});

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.manifestHash = manifestDigest;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.integrity.manifestHash = manifestDigest;



return {

ok: true,

seedSha256: seedSha,

manifestHash: manifestDigest

};

} catch (err) {

return { ok: false, error: String(err) };

}

}



/**

* attachPqSignatureReference()

* - Placeholder to attach a PQ signature reference after HSM signing.

* - Inputs: signatureRef (string), pubkeyRef (string)

*/

function attachPqSignatureReference({ signatureRef, pubkeyRef }) {

if (!signatureRef || !pubkeyRef) {

throw new Error("signatureRef and pubkeyRef required");

}

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.pqSignatureRef = signatureRef;

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signerPublicKeyRef = pubkeyRef;

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signatureVerification = "PENDING";

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.pqSignatureRef = signatureRef;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.signer.publicKeyRef = pubkeyRef;

return true;

}



/**

* verifyAttestationPlaceholder()

* - Calls the placeholder PQ verify helper (actual verify must be done by HSM/PQ libs).

*/

async function verifyAttestationPlaceholder() {

const payload = {

seed: V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED,

manifest: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST

};

const { pqSignatureRef, signerPublicKeyRef } = V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation;

const check = await CryptoUtil.verifyPQSignature({

payload,

signature: pqSignatureRef, // placeholder token pointing to real HSM sig

publicKeyRef: signerPublicKeyRef

});

if (check.ok) {

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signatureVerification = "VERIFIED_PLACEHOLDER";

}

return check;

}

priority: this.calculatePriority(i, category),

retries: 0

});

}

return checklist;

}

async executeAudit(audit) {

try {

result: formatted,

status: result.status,

};

}

this.auditChecklist = [...failedAudits, ...remaining];

}



generateReport() {

totalAudits: this.state.totalAudits,

passed: this.state.passed,

delay(ms) {

);

}



if (this.state.cycleCount % this.config.reorganizeInterval === 0) {

this.state.isRunning = false;

/* ------------------------------

4) Minimal manifest & audit record (mutable only until signing)

------------------------------ */

const V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST = {

manifestId: "v15-manifest-2025-10-28",

createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),

seedRef: "V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED",

seedSha256: "PLACEHOLDER_SEED_SHA256", // fill in after computing genuine digest in secure environment

pointsCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.length,

criticalCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="CRITICAL").length,

highCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="HIGH").length,

mediumCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="MEDIUM").length,

lowCount: V15_FINAL_200_POINTS.filter(p=>p.priority==="LOW").length,

attestation: {

pqSignatureRef: "PLACEHOLDER_PQ_SIG_REF",

signerPublicKeyRef: "PLACEHOLDER_PQ_PUBKEY_REF",

signatureVerification: "PENDING" // set to "VERIFIED" after HSM verify step

},

notes: "This manifest must be sealed (PQ-signed) by an HSM-managed key and anchored into CCR before distribution."

};



/* ------------------------------

5) Release helper functions (safe to call in auditor env)

------------------------------ */



/**

* computeAndAttachManifestHashes()

* - Computes hash of immutables and returns a manifest snapshot that auditors can sign.

* - Warning: compute the hashes in a secure environment (HSM/air-gapped if required).

*/

async function computeAndAttachManifestHashes() {

try {

// Compute seed SHA256

const seedSha = await CryptoUtil.sha256Hex(V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED);

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.seedSha256 = seedSha;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.integrity.sha256 = seedSha;



// Compute manifest summary hash

const manifestDigest = await CryptoUtil.sha256Hex({

manifestId: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.manifestId,

seedSha256: seedSha,

pointsCount: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.pointsCount,

createdAt: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.createdAt

});

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.manifestHash = manifestDigest;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.integrity.manifestHash = manifestDigest;



return {

ok: true,

seedSha256: seedSha,

manifestHash: manifestDigest

};

} catch (err) {

return { ok: false, error: String(err) };

}

}



/**

* attachPqSignatureReference()

* - Placeholder to attach a PQ signature reference after HSM signing.

* - Inputs: signatureRef (string), pubkeyRef (string)

*/

function attachPqSignatureReference({ signatureRef, pubkeyRef }) {

if (!signatureRef || !pubkeyRef) {

throw new Error("signatureRef and pubkeyRef required");

}

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.pqSignatureRef = signatureRef;

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signerPublicKeyRef = pubkeyRef;

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signatureVerification = "PENDING";

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.pqSignatureRef = signatureRef;

V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED.HARDENED_RELEASE.signer.publicKeyRef = pubkeyRef;

return true;

}



/**

* verifyAttestationPlaceholder()

* - Calls the placeholder PQ verify helper (actual verify must be done by HSM/PQ libs).

*/

async function verifyAttestationPlaceholder() {

const payload = {

seed: V15_MASTER_GENESIS_SEED,

manifest: V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST

};

const { pqSignatureRef, signerPublicKeyRef } = V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation;

const check = await CryptoUtil.verifyPQSignature({

payload,

signature: pqSignatureRef, // placeholder token pointing to real HSM sig

publicKeyRef: signerPublicKeyRef

});

if (check.ok) {

V15_AUDIT_MANIFEST.attestation.signatureVerification = "VERIFIED_PLACEHOLDER";

}

return check;

}

        <section id="methods-infographic" class="mb-20">
            <h2 class="text-4xl font-extrabold text-center text-[#FFC300] mb-8">Our Unique 12-Point Learning Method</h2>
            <p class="text-center max-w-4xl mx-auto text-lg text-[#E0E0E0] mb-12">These core principles are woven into every lesson, shifting your mindset from studying to naturally acquiring the English language.</p>

            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
                <div class="bg-[#7D3C98] text-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow-2xl pillar-card col-span-1 lg:col-span-2">
                    <div class="text-5xl mb-3">ðŸ‘¶</div>
                    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">Learn Like a Native</h3>
                    <p class="text-sm">Our method models childhood language acquisition: start by listening and mimicking. Speaking, grammar, reading, and writing develop **naturally** over time.</p>

                    <div class="text-5xl mb-3">âœ…</div>
                    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">Focus on Comprehensible Input (60%)</h3>
                    <p class="text-sm">Listen to material you **already understand at least 60%** of the time. This focus on context allows effortless meaning-grasping and is the foundation of fluency.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="bg-[#FFC300] text-black p-6 rounded-xl shadow-2xl pillar-card">
                    <div class="text-5xl mb-3">ðŸ—£ï¸</div>

                    <div class="text-5xl mb-3 text-[#FFC300]">ðŸš«</div>
                    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">Break the Grammar Barrier</h3>
                    <p class="text-sm">We don't drill complex rules. Just like a native speaker, grammar will come to you **naturally** after communication fluency is achieved.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="bg-[#222222] text-[#E0E0E0] p-6 rounded-xl shadow-2xl border-t-4 border-[#7D3C98] pillar-card">

                <div class="bg-[#222222] text-[#E0E0E0] p-6 rounded-xl shadow-2xl border-t-4 border-[#FFC300] pillar-card">
                    <div class="text-5xl mb-3 text-[#FFC300]">ðŸ§ </div>
                    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">Relevant Vocabulary & Association</h3>
                    <p class="text-sm">We introduce **relevant vocabulary** through full sentences and natural conversation, utilizing associationâ€”the proven way your brain makes language connections.</p>

                contentDisplay.innerHTML = '';

                    card.innerHTML = `
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-3 text-[#FFC300]">${title}</h3>
                        <div class="max-h-96 overflow-y-scroll space-y-1">${itemsHtml}</div>
                    `;
                    contentDisplay.appendChild(card);
                }
            };

            const renderContent = (lessonNumber) => {
                contentDisplay.innerHTML = '';
                
                let dataToRender = [];
                if (currentPillar === 'All') {
                    // Lesson view: show all pillars for the selected lesson
                    dataToRender = lessonData.filter(item => item.lesson == lessonNumber);
                    const pillarOrder = ['Communication', 'Business', 'AI'];
                    dataToRender.sort((a, b) => pillarOrder.indexOf(a.pillar) - pillarOrder.indexOf(b.pillar));
                    contentDisplay.className = 'grid gap-6 mt-8 grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3';
                } else {
                    // Pillar filter view: show all lessons for the selected pillar
                    dataToRender = lessonData.filter(item => item.pillar === currentPillar);
                    dataToRender.sort((a, b) => a.lesson - b.lesson);
                    contentDisplay.className = 'grid gap-6 mt-8 grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3';
                }
                
                dataToRender.forEach(item => {
                    const titleText = currentPillar === 'All' ? `${pillarIcons[item.pillar]} ${item.pillar}` : `Lesson ${item.lesson}`;
                    const subtitleText = `<span class="text-sm font-normal text-[#FFC300] ml-1">(${item.topic})</span>`;

                    let contentHTML = `
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-lg mb-2 text-[#7D3C98]">${titleText}</h4>`;
                    
                    if (item.pillar === 'Communication') {
                        contentHTML += `
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-semibold mt-1 mb-2">${subtitleText}</p>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1"><strong>Core Vocab (10):</strong> ${item.vocab.join(', ')}</p>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1"><strong>Idioms/Slang (8):</strong> ${item.idioms.join('; ')}</p>`;
                    } else {
                         contentHTML += `
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-semibold mt-1 mb-2">${subtitleText}</p>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1"><strong>Vocab (5):</strong> ${item.vocab.join(', ')}</p>`;
                    }

                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = `content-card bg-[#222222] p-4 rounded-xl transition duration-300 hover:bg-[#333333] ${pillarColors[item.pillar]}`;
                    card.innerHTML = contentHTML;
                    contentDisplay.appendChild(card);
                });
            };

            // Initialize Lesson Dropdown
            for (let i = 1; i <= 20; i++) {
                const option = document.createElement('option');
                option.value = i;
                option.textContent = `Lesson ${i}`;
                lessonSelect.appendChild(option);
            }

            // --- Event Listeners ---

            // Lesson Dropdown Change
            lessonSelect.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                currentPillar = 'All';
                navButtons.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                document.getElementById('btn-all').classList.add('active');
                renderContent(e.target.value);
            });
            
            // Pillar Filter Buttons
            navButtons.forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    navButtons.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                    btn.classList.add('active');
                    
                    const id = btn.id;
                    if (id === 'btn-all') {
                        currentPillar = 'All';
                    } else if (id === 'btn-biz') {
                        currentPillar = 'Business';
                    } else if (id === 'btn-comm') {
                        currentPillar = 'Communication';
                    } else if (id === 'btn-ai') {
                        currentPillar = 'AI';
                    }
                    renderContent(lessonSelect.value);
                });
            });

            // Tab Switcher
            tabLessons.addEventListener('click', () => {
                currentView = 'lessons';
                tabGlossary.classList.remove('active-tab');
                tabLessons.classList.add('active-tab');
                lessonControls.classList.remove('hidden');
                renderContent(lessonSelect.value);
            });

            tabGlossary.addEventListener('click', () => {
                currentView = 'glossary';
                tabLessons.classList.remove('active-tab');
                tabGlossary.classList.add('active-tab');
                lessonControls.classList.add('hidden');
                renderGlossary();
            });

            // Initial Load
            renderContent(1); 

            // --- Chart Initialization ---

            const chartColors = {
                purple: '#7D3C98', darkPurple: '#4B0082', gold: '#FFC300', orange: '#FF9900',
                red: '#990000', lightSilver: '#E0E0E0', text: '#E0E0E0', grid: '#333333', background: '#222222'
            };

            const tooltipTitleCallback = (tooltipItems) => {
                const item = tooltipItems[0];
                let label = item.chart.data.labels[item.dataIndex];
                if (Array.isArray(label)) return label.join(' ');
                return label;
            };

            // Chart 1: Focus Chart (3 Pillars)
            new Chart(document.getElementById('focusChart').getContext('2d'), {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: ['Communication English', 'Business English', 'AI English'],
                    datasets: [{ data: [33.3, 33.3, 33.4], backgroundColor: [chartColors.orange, chartColors.gold, chartColors.purple], borderColor: chartColors.background, borderWidth: 4 }]
                },
                options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { color: chartColors.text, font: { size: 12, weight: 'bold' } } }, tooltip: { callbacks: { title: tooltipTitleCallback } } } }
            });
            
            // Chart 2: Lexical Chart
            const commTotal = commCoreVocab.length + commIdioms.length + commSlang.length;
            const lexicalData = {
                business: bizVocab.length,
                communication: commTotal,
                ai: aiVocab.length,
            };

            new Chart(document.getElementById('lexicalChart').getContext('2d'), {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: ['Communication (Vocab, Idioms, Slang)', 'Business Terms', 'AI/Tech Terms'],
                    datasets: [{ label: 'Total Lexical Items', data: [lexicalData.communication, lexicalData.business, lexicalData.ai], backgroundColor: [chartColors.orange, chartColors.gold, chartColors.purple] }]
                },
                options: { 
                    responsive: true, 
                    maintainAspectRatio: false, 
                    scales: { 
                        y: { 
                            beginAtZero: true, 
                            grid: { color: chartColors.grid }, 
                            ticks: { color: chartColors.text } 
                        }, 
                        x: { 
                            grid: { display: false }, 
                            ticks: { color: chartColors.text, font: { size: 10 } } 
                        } 
                    }, 
                    plugins: { 
                        legend: { display: false }, 
                        tooltip: { callbacks: { title: tooltipTitleCallback } } 
                    } 
                } 
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>The Power of Context: An ESL Guide</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }
        .chart-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 400px;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
            height: 300px;
            max-height: 350px;
        }
        @media (min-width: 640px) {
            .chart-container {
                height: 350px;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100" style="background-color: #F8F9FA;">

    <div class="container mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8">
        
        <header class="text-center my-8 md:my-12">
            <h1 class="text-4xl md:text-6xl font-black" style="color: #003F5C;">The Power of Context</h1>
            <p class="text-lg md:text-xl mt-2" style="color: #7A5195;">Don't Let One Word Stop You. Hear the Real Message!</p>
        </header>

        <main>
            <section id="what-is-context" class="mb-12 md:mb-16">
                <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 md:p-8 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 items-center">
                    <div class="text-content">
                        <h2 class="text-3xl font-bold mb-4" style="color: #003F5C;">What is Context?</h2>
                        <p class="text-gray-700 mb-4">
                            Context is the full pictureâ€”the situation, the topic, and all the words around a message. In most sentences, you already understand the vast majority of the words. These known words give you the context you need to understand the main idea, even if one or two words are new.
                        </p>
                        <p class="text-gray-700 font-bold" style="color: #BC5090;">
                            Your goal is to focus on what you DO know, not what you don't.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="visualization">
                        <div class="chart-container">
                            <canvas id="knownWordsChart"></canvas>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-center text-sm mt-2 text-gray-600">You typically know over 90% of the words in a conversation. That's enough to get the main idea!</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <section id="listening-trap" class="mb-12 md:mb-16">
                <h2 class="text-3xl font-bold text-center mb-8" style="color: #003F5C;">The Listening Trap vs. The Flow of Context</h2>
                 <p class="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto text-gray-700 mb-8">Many learners fall into the "Listening Trap" because they fear making mistakes. When they hear an unknown word, they stop and panic. The correct way is to keep listening and use the "Flow of Context" to find the meaning.</p>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 border-4 border-red-300">
                        <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-center mb-4" style="color: #D43D51;">The Listening Trap ðŸ‘Ž</h3>
                        <div class="space-y-4 text-center">
                            <div class="p-3 bg-red-100 rounded-md">Hear a new word</div>
                            <div class="text-5xl font-bold text-red-400">â‡©</div>
                            <div class="p-3 bg-red-100 rounded-md font-bold">STOP LISTENING</div>
                            <div class="text-5xl font-bold text-red-400">â‡©</div>
                            <div class="p-3 bg-red-100 rounded-md">Focus only on the unknown word</div>
                             <div class="text-5xl font-bold text-red-400">â‡©</div>
                            <div class="p-3 bg-red-200 rounded-md font-bold">Miss the main message</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 border-4 border-green-300">
                        <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-center mb-4" style="color: #008F68;">The Flow of Context ðŸ‘</h3>
                        <div class="space-y-4 text-center">
                            <div class="p-3 bg-green-100 rounded-md">Hear a new word</div>
                            <div class="text-5xl font-bold text-green-400">â‡©</div>
                            <div class="p-3 bg-green-100 rounded-md font-bold">KEEP LISTENING</div>
                            <div class="text-5xl font-bold text-green-400">â‡©</div>
                            <div class="p-3 bg-green-100 rounded-md">Use other words to find meaning</div>
                             <div class="text-5xl font-bold text-green-400">â‡©</div>
                            <div class="p-3 bg-green-200 rounded-md font-bold">Understand the main message!</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>
            
            <section id="examples" class="mb-12 md:mb-16">
                 <h2 class="text-3xl font-bold text-center mb-8" style="color: #003F5C;">Ignoring the "Noise"</h2>
                 <p class="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto text-gray-700 mb-8">English speakers often add "noise" words to common phrases for style or emphasis. These words don't change the core meaning. Let's see how small the "noise" really is.</p>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
                    
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 text-center">
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">How <span class="text-red-500">the heck</span> are you?</h3>
                        <p class="text-gray-600 mb-4">Core Idea: "How are you?"</p>
                        <div class="chart-container h-64">
                            <canvas id="heckChart"></canvas>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 text-center">
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">What's new <span class="text-red-500">and exciting</span>?</h3>
                        <p class="text-gray-600 mb-4">Core Idea: "What's new?"</p>
                        <div class="chart-container h-64">
                            <canvas id="excitingChart"></canvas>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 text-center">
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">What have you been <span class="text-red-500">up to</span>?</h3>
                        <p class="text-gray-600 mb-4">Core Idea: "What have you been doing?"</p>
                        <div class="chart-container h-64">
                            <canvas id="upToChart"></canvas>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <section id="practice">
                <h2 class="text-3xl font-bold text-center mb-8" style="color: #003F5C;">Practice: Find the Context Clues</h2>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8">

                    <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 flex flex-col">
                        <p class="text-gray-800 mb-4 flex-grow">"I was late for my class, so I ran quickly to the door. When I got inside, the professor was already speaking. I found an empty seat near the back and tried to <span class="font-bold p-1 rounded" style="background-color: #FFD6A5; color: #BF5B04;">eavesdrop</span> on the lecture. I hoped he hadn't covered any important details yet."</p>
                        <div class="mt-auto">
                            <p class="font-bold" style="color: #7A5195;">Context Clues:</p>
                            <ul class="list-none space-y-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                <li><span>âœ“</span> Late for class</li>
                                <li><span>âœ“</span> Professor was speaking</li>
                                <li><span>âœ“</span> Tried to listen</li>
                            </ul>
                            <p class="mt-3 text-lg"><b style="color:#003F5C;">Meaning:</b> To listen secretly.</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 flex flex-col">
                        <p class="text-gray-800 mb-4 flex-grow">"My friend, Liam, told me he had a <span class="font-bold p-1 rounded" style="background-color: #FFD6A5; color: #BF5B04;">grueling</span> week at work. He worked 12 hours a day every day and had no time for his hobbies. He looked very tired and said he just wanted to go home and sleep for 14 hours."</p>
                        <div class="mt-auto">
                           <p class="font-bold" style="color: #7A5195;">Context Clues:</p>
                            <ul class="list-none space-y-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                <li><span>âœ“</span> Worked 12 hours a day</li>
                                <li><span>âœ“</span> Looked very tired</li>
                                <li><span>âœ“</span> No time for hobbies</li>
                            </ul>
                            <p class="mt-3 text-lg"><b style="color:#003F5C;">Meaning:</b> Very difficult or exhausting.</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 flex flex-col">
                        <p class="text-gray-800 mb-4 flex-grow">"We had a great time at the new restaurant. The food was excellent and the service was very fast. The only small issue was the high price. We decided we would <span class="font-bold p-1 rounded" style="background-color: #FFD6A5; color: #BF5B04;">patronize</span> the place again only for special occasions because it was too expensive."</p>
                         <div class="mt-auto">
                           <p class="font-bold" style="color: #7A5195;">Context Clues:</p>
                            <ul class="list-none space-y-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                <li><span>âœ“</span> Great food and service</li>
                                <li><span>âœ“</span> High price / expensive</li>
                                <li><span>âœ“</span> Will visit for special occasions</li>
                            </ul>
                            <p class="mt-3 text-lg"><b style="color:#003F5C;">Meaning:</b> To visit or be a customer.</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                </div>
            </section>

        </main>
        
        <footer class="text-center my-12">
            <p class="text-xl font-bold" style="color: #003F5C;">Keep Listening, Keep Learning!</p>
            <p class="text-gray-600">The more you practice, the easier it gets.</p>
        </footer>

    </div>

    <script>
        const brilliantBluesPalette = ['#003F5C', '#BC5090', '#FFA600', '#FF764A', '#EF5675'];
        const knownVsUnknownPalette = ['#374C80', '#FF764A'];
        const phrasePalette = ['#003F5C', '#EF5675'];

        const tooltipCallback = {
            plugins: {
                tooltip: {
                    callbacks: {
                        title: function(tooltipItems) {
                            const item = tooltipItems[0];
                            let label = item.chart.data.labels[item.dataIndex];
                            if (Array.isArray(label)) {
                              return label.join(' ');
                            } else {
                              return label;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                legend: {
                    position: 'bottom',
                }
            }
        };

        const createDonutChart = (ctx, labels, data, colors) => {
            new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: labels,
                    datasets: [{
                        label: 'Word Count',
                        data: data,
                        backgroundColor: colors,
                        borderColor: '#F8F9FA',
                        borderWidth: 4,
                        hoverOffset: 8
                    }]
                },
                options: { ...tooltipCallback, maintainAspectRatio: false, responsive: true }
            });
        };
        
        const knownWordsCtx = document.getElementById('knownWordsChart').getContext('2d');
        createDonutChart(knownWordsCtx, ['Known Words', 'Unknown Words'], [95, 5], knownVsUnknownPalette);

        const heckCtx = document.getElementById('heckChart').getContext('2d');
        createDonutChart(heckCtx, ['Known Words', '"Noise" Words'], [3, 2], phrasePalette);

        const excitingCtx = document.getElementById('excitingChart').getContext('2d');
        createDonutChart(excitingCtx, ['Known Words', '"Noise" Words'], [2, 2], phrasePalette);

        const upToCtx = document.getElementById('upToChart').getContext('2d');
        createDonutChart(upToCtx, ['Known Words', '"Noise" Words'], [4, 2], phrasePalette);
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>NET - Natural English Training - Pronunciation Training</title>
    <!-- Load Tailwind CSS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@100..900&display=swap');
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background-color: #f0f4f8; /* Light background */
            padding: 20px;
        }

        /* Defining the "Slide Block" for easy screenshotting */
        .slide-block {
            width: 800px; /* Fixed Width */
            height: 450px; /* Fixed Height (Approx. 16:9 ratio) */
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #f9f9f9 100%);
            border-radius: 16px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
            padding: 30px;
            margin: 25px auto; /* Centered, with space between slides */
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
            overflow: hidden; /* Ensures content stays within the box */
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        .slide-title {
            color: #1e40af; /* Deep Blue Title */
            border-bottom: 2px solid #bfdbfe;
            padding-bottom: 5px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            font-size: 1.75rem;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .section-heading {
            color: #3b82f6;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .phonics-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
        }

        /* Custom styles for specific content areas */
        .twister-box {
            background-color: #fefce8; /* Yellow 50 */
            border: 1px dashed #fcd34d; /* Yellow 300 */
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!--
    ================================================================
    PAGE 1/25: ENGLISH INTRODUCTION & TIPS
    ================================================================
    -->
    <div class="slide-block">
        <div>
            <h1 class="slide-title">NET - Natural English Training: Pronunciation</h1>
            <h2 class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-gray-800 mb-4">Welcome to NET! Your Pronunciation Journey</h2>

            <p class="text-lg text-gray-700 mb-6">
                Improving how you sound is key to confident communication! We're using the **Jolly Phonics** system, a highly effective method from the UK, to master the 42 sounds of English.
            </p>

            <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold section-heading mt-4">Pro Tips for Amazing Pronunciation</h2>
            <ul class="list-disc list-inside space-y-2 text-gray-600 ml-4">
                <li class="font-medium text-blue-800">Go through each phonic sound and find where you are weak. Focus on your problem spots!</li>
                <li>**Mimic native speakers**: Watch films and listen to music. Try to copy their sound exactly.</li>
                <li>**Practice tongue twisters**: They train your mouth muscles to move fast and accurately.</li>
                <li>**Record your voice** and compare it to a native speaker. Hearing the difference is the first step to fixing it.</li>
            </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="text-right text-sm text-gray-500">Slide 1 of 25 (English)</div>
    </div>

    <!--
    ================================================================
    PAGE 2/25: JOLLY PHONICS SYSTEM & GROUPS
    ================================================================
    -->
    <div class="slide-block">
        <div>
            <h1 class="slide-title">The Phonics System: Sounds vs. Letters</h1>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                    <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold section-heading">Why 42 Sounds? (7 Groups Total)</h2>
                    <ul class="list-disc list-inside space-y-2 text-gray-600 ml-4 mt-2">
                        <li>English uses **42 distinct sounds** (phonemes), but only 26 letters!</li>
                        <li>These sounds are divided into **7 learning groups** for easy practice.</li>
                        <li>**Phonetic words**: Read exactly as written (e.g., <strong class="text-green-600">cat, sit, run</strong>).</li>
                        <li>**Non-phonetic words**: "Tricky words" that must be memorized (e.g., <strong class="text-red-600">said, was, through</strong>).</li>
                    </ul>
                    <p class="mt-4 text-base font-medium text-blue-800 bg-blue-100 p-3 rounded-lg">
                        Your goal is to train your ear and mouth to recognize and produce all 42 sounds accurately.
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold section-heading">7 Groups of Jolly Phonics</h2>
                    <div class="grid phonics-grid gap-2 text-center text-xs font-mono p-2 bg-yellow-50 rounded-xl shadow-inner">
                        <!-- Group 1 -->
                        <div class="p-2 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg bg-white shadow-sm"><span class="font-bold text-yellow-800">G1:</span> s, a, t, i, p, n</div>
                        <!-- Group 2 -->
                        <div class="p-2 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg bg-white shadow-sm"><span class="font-bold text-yellow-800">G2:</span> c k, e, h, r, m, d</div>
                        <!-- Group 3 -->
                        <div class="p-2 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg bg-white shadow-sm"><span class="font-bold text-yellow-800">G3:</span> g, o, u, l, f, b</div>
                        <!-- Group 4 -->
                        <div class="p-2 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg bg-white shadow-sm"><span class="font-bold text-yellow-800">G4:</span> ai, j, oa, ie, ee, or</div>
                        <!-- Group 5 -->
                        <div class="p-2 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg bg-white shadow-sm"><span class="font-bold text-yellow-800">G5:</span> z, w, ng, v, oo, oo</div>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>The Phoenix Arsenal: Rebuilt Nexus (V12.0 - Evolved)</title>
    <!-- Load Tailwind CSS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        /* --- FND Protocol Colors --- */
        :root {
            --nexus-gold: #FFD700; /* Primary Accent */
            --nexus-purple: #A020F0; /* Secondary Accent */
            --nexus-dark: #0A0A1F; /* Deep Background */
            --nexus-card: rgba(16, 16, 30, 0.7); /* Translucent Card BG */
            --heartbeat-color: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.5); /* Initial Heartbeat */
            --heartbeat-duration: 2s; /* Initial Heartbeat Speed */
        }
        
        /* Global Aesthetic and Font */
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background-color: var(--nexus-dark);
            color: #E0E0E0;
            min-height: 100vh;
            background-image: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(160, 32, 240, 0.1) 0%, rgba(10, 10, 31, 1) 50%);
        }
        
        /* Neon Glow Utility */
        .neon-gold {
            color: var(--nexus-gold);
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.6);
        }
        .neon-purple {
            color: var(--nexus-purple);
            text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(160, 32, 240, 0.6);
        }

        /* Category Button & Arsenal Card Base */
        .category-button, .arsenal-card {
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
        }
        
        /* Category Button Active State */
        .category-button.active {
            border-color: var(--nexus-gold) !important;
            color: var(--nexus-gold) !important;
            background-color: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.1);
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.4);
        }

        /* Card Interaction */
        .arsenal-card {
            border: 1px solid rgba(160, 32, 240, 0.3);
            cursor: pointer;
            backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
        }
        .arsenal-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            border-color: var(--nexus-purple);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(160, 32, 240, 0.3), 0 0 15px rgba(160, 32, 240, 0.4);
        }
        
        /* Deployment Lock State */
        .card-locked {
            opacity: 0.5;
            pointer-events: none;
            cursor: default;
            border-color: #00FFFF !important; /* Cyan Lock Glow */
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px #00FFFF; 
        }

        /* Game Input Styles */
        .game-input { background-color: var(--nexus-dark); border: 1px solid var(--nexus-purple); color: var(--nexus-gold); }

        /* --- HEARTBEAT ADDITION (V12.0) --- */
        @keyframes heartbeat-glow {
            0% { box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--heartbeat-color); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--heartbeat-color), 0 0 25px var(--heartbeat-color); }
            100% { box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--heartbeat-color); }
        }
        .system-heartbeat {
            animation: heartbeat-glow var(--heartbeat-duration) infinite ease-in-out;
        }

        /* --- CRASH LOG MODAL (V12.0) --- */
        #system-modal {
            background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            z-index: 50;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- CRASH LOG MODAL (Hidden by default) -->
    <div id="system-modal" class="fixed inset-0 hidden items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div class="bg-gray-900 border-4 border-red-600 rounded-xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-2xl system-heartbeat" style="--heartbeat-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.7); --heartbeat-duration: 0.5s;">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 border-b border-red-600 pb-2">
                <h3 class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-red-500">ðŸ”¥ CATASTROPHIC REPORT (DAEDALUS)</h3>
                <button onclick="document.getElementById('system-modal').classList.add('hidden')" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-white text-2xl leading-none">&times;</button>
            </div>
            <p class="text-sm mb-4 text-gray-300">A high-priority error was detected during a simulated forge attempt. See log details below:</p>
            <div class="bg-gray-800 p-3 rounded text-sm overflow-x-auto">
                <pre id="modal-error-details" class="text-red-300"></pre>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>


    <!-- Main Application Container -->
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 sm:p-8">

        <!-- Header: The Phoenix Arsenal -->
        <header class="text-center mb-12 pt-4">
            <h1 class="text-6xl sm:text-7xl font-extrabold neon-gold tracking-tight mb-2 uppercase system-heartbeat" id="system-title">
                PHOENIX NEXUS
            </h1>
            <p class="text-xl sm:text-2xl neon-purple font-light">
                ACTION FILE ARSENAL V12.0 (Evolved)
            </p>
            <div class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">60 Core Concepts Mapped. Awaiting Deployment Authorization.</div>
        </header>
        
        <!-- Category Selector -->
        <div class="flex justify-center flex-wrap gap-3 mb-10">
            <!-- Buttons dynamically styled by JS -->
        </div>

        <!-- Arsenal Inventory Grid -->
        <div id="arsenal-grid" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
            <!-- Concept Cards Rendered Here -->
        </div>

        <!-- Game Preview/Simulator Area -->
        <div id="game-preview" class="mt-12 p-8 rounded-xl border-2 border-nexus-purple bg-nexus-card shadow-2xl hidden">
            <h2 class="text-3xl font-extrabold mb-4 neon-gold border-b border-nexus-purple pb-2">Simulator: <span id="preview-title"></span></h2>
            <div id="preview-content" class="min-h-[250px] flex items-center justify-center p-4">
                <!-- Game will load here -->
            </div>
            <p class="mt-4 text-sm text-center text-gray-400">
                (Simulated Environment. Local Logic Deployment Only.)
            </p>
        </div>


        <!-- Footer for System Status -->
        <footer class="text-center mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-gray-800">
            <div id="transfer-status" class="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold"></div>
        </footer>

    </div>

    <script>
        // ====================================================================================================
        // --- ARSENAL DATA (CONCEPTS 1-60 MERGED) ---
        // ====================================================================================================
        
        // Simulates persistent storage for lock status
        let lockedConcepts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('phoenix_locks')) || {}; 
        
        const arsenalConcepts = [

            // PHASE VI: WRAP-UPS (Concepts 51-60)
            { id: 51, title: "The Three-Point Summary", focus: "Living Lesson", icon: "ðŸ”–", category: "wrapup", description: "Students summarize the lesson using three key vocabulary words or grammatical rules." },
            { id: 52, title: "Phoenix Rebirth Reflection", focus: "Confidence Engine", icon: "âœ¨", category: "wrapup", description: "Students state one thing they struggled with (ash) and one thing they mastered (phoenix)." },
            { id: 53, title: "Next Action Protocol", focus: "Scenario Simulator", icon: "ðŸš€", category: "wrapup", description: "Students describe one real-world scenario where they will immediately apply the concept." },
            { id: 54, title: "Exit Ticket Architect", focus: "Living Lesson", icon: "ðŸŽ«", category: "wrapup", description: "Students write a complex conditional sentence summarizing the lesson's core dependency." },
            { id: 55, title: "The Question Burner", focus: "Confidence Engine", icon: "â“", category: "wrapup", description: "Students write down any unanswered question they still have before leaving." },
            { id: 56, title: "The Jargon Report", focus: "Living Lesson", icon: "ðŸ“°", category: "wrapup", description: "Students convert a piece of academic/technical language used in the lesson back into plain English." },
            { id: 57, title: "The Tense Review Filter", focus: "Living Lesson", icon: "ðŸ•’", category: "wrapup", description: "Students state one action they did, one they are doing, and one they will do, related to the lesson." },
            { id: 58, title: "Error Forgiveness Protocol", focus: "Confidence Engine", icon: "âŒ", category: "wrapup", description: "Students identify the biggest mistake they made in class and correctly reformulate the sentence." },
            { id: 59, title: "Concept Connection Chain", focus: "Scenario Simulator", icon: "ðŸ”—", category: "wrapup", description: "Students connect the day's lesson topic to a topic from a previous lesson." },
